promise: Amazon would power 100% of its operations with renewable energy by 2025.
description: After pledging 100% renewables by 2030 in the 2019 Climate Pledge, Amazon announced in mid-2020 it would reach the goal by 2025, five years early, backed by hundreds of wind and solar projects. In July 2023 Amazon announced it had already achieved 100% renewable energy matching for 2023.
evidence: Amazon announced July 2023 that it matched 100% of electricity with renewables
Hundreds of utility-scale wind/solar projects procured across 20+ countries
Goal reached two years ahead of the 2025 deadline

promise: "We believe that, in 2025, we may see the first AI agents 'join the workforce' and materially change the output of companies."
description: Written in Altman's "Reflections" blog post in January 2025. During 2025 OpenAI shipped Operator, Deep Research, ChatGPT agent payments and Codex, and enterprises began deploying agents — but agents' workforce integration remained largely assistive and limited, not the material, autonomous workforce transformation predicted.
evidence: OpenAI launched Operator (Jan 2025), Deep Research (Feb 2025), agent payments (Mar 2025)
2025 enterprise adoption of agents grew rapidly but remained supervised/limited
Altman's own 2025 statements characterized agents as a decade-scale transition

promise: We're taking it back (the Panama Canal)
description: In his joint address to Congress Trump vowed the US would 'take back' the Panama Canal, escalating against Panamanian control. Under pressure, Hong Kong's CK Hutchison sold its Panama port stakes to a US-led BlackRock consortium (June 2025), which Trump hailed as victory, but the canal itself remains under Panamanian sovereignty and tolls were not materially changed.
evidence: BlackRock/Bezos consortium acquired the two Panama port terminals in June 2025
Canal remains operated by Panama; Trump claimed vindication over the port deal
sources: Wikipedia: Second presidency of Donald Trump

promise: The US will take over the Gaza Strip, and we will do a job with it, too
description: Announced at a press conference with Netanyahu that the US would take over and redevelop Gaza. No US takeover ever occurred; the initiative was superseded by the Trump-brokered Gaza ceasefire/peace framework signed in October 2025, which involved a US 'guarantee' role, not a takeover.
evidence: No US administration of Gaza was ever established
October 2025 Trump peace plan signed by Israel, Hamas and Gazan representatives instead

promise: We will smash the gangs
description: Starmer promised at Labour conference to 'smash' the people-smuggling gangs to stop small-boat Channel crossings. Crossings instead hit a record annual high in 2025, rising year on year, despite the new Border Security Command and a France 'one-in, one-out' returns deal that began in August 2025.
evidence: 2025 saw a record number of Channel crossings, up on 2024
First France returns flights were cancelled in Sept 2025 amid legal challenges

promise: We will deliver the fastest growth in the G7
description: Reeves repeatedly promised the UK would become the fastest-growing G7 economy under Labour. Through 2025 the UK was instead one of the slowest-growing G7 economies, with near-flat quarterly growth, and the target was quietly dropped.
evidence: UK growth lagged most G7 peers through 2025
Quarterly growth often 0.1-0.4%, repeatedly below the G7 average

promise: Meta AI will be the most used AI assistant in the world, with 1 billion users, by the end of 2025
description: On the Q4 2024 earnings call Zuckerberg said Meta AI was on track to be the world's most-used assistant by end of 2025, targeting 1 billion users. Meta reported roughly 700-800 million monthly users by late 2025 - strong growth but short of the 1 billion goal and still contesting ChatGPT for the top spot.
evidence: Meta AI reached ~800M MAU (Oct 2025), below the 1B target
'Most used assistant' claim disputed by ChatGPT's similar user base

promise: GPT-5 will be released this year (2025)
description: Altman and OpenAI promised GPT-5 would ship in 2025. It launched on August 7, 2025 via livestream event, with 'thinking' and 'mini' variants, marking OpenAI's first true multi-modal model release of the year - on schedule versus the stated 2025 window.
evidence: GPT-5 launched August 7, 2025
Shipped before the promised end-of-2025 deadline

promise: Siri gets a major overhaul... coming next year (2025)
description: At WWDC 2024 Apple (with Cook's backing) promised a new conversational Siri powered by Apple Intelligence arriving 'next year'. In March 2025 Apple admitted the overhaul would take 'longer than expected', and it was later pushed to 2026 or beyond - the most public delayed feature in Apple's AI rollout.
evidence: Apple admitted delay in March 2025 statement
Bloomberg reported the revamp slipped to 2026; WWDC June 2025 showed no new Siri

promise: The currency controls (cepo) will be eliminated in 2025
description: Milei promised to end Argentina's capital controls in 2025. After an IMF $20 billion program was secured (April 2025) ending most controls, the remaining restrictions were lifted in December 2025 and the peso was floated, devaluing sharply - the long-promised exit from the cepo was delivered within the year.
evidence: IMF $20B deal (April 2025) accompanied by removal of most capital controls (AP)
Remaining controls lifted and peso floated in December 2025

promise: The working week will be reduced to 37.5 hours by the end of 2025
description: Sanchez's coalition committed to cutting the legal work week from 40 to 37.5 hours by end-2025 without loss of pay. Spain's Congress approved the 37.5-hour week law in September 2025, with implementation rolling out through 2026 - the deadline was met.
evidence: Congress approved the 37.5-hour law in September 2025
Law retains no wage-loss clause for affected workers

promise: Power bills will be $275 lower by 2025
description: Labor's 2022 election platform, costed by the Parliamentary Budget Office, promised household power bills would be $275 a year lower by 2025 under its 82% renewables target. Electricity prices instead rose sharply after the 2022 energy crisis; wholesale prices fell from 2024 but retail bills remained well above 2022 levels, and Albanese himself acknowledged by 2024 that bills had not fallen as promised.
evidence: Retail electricity prices rose, not fell, over 2022-2024 in most states
Albanese conceded in 2024 that power bills had not come down $275 as promised

promise: From 2025, all new passenger cars sold in Norway will be zero-emission
description: Norway's cross-party national target — reaffirmed in Støre's government platform in October 2021 — was that all new passenger cars sold from 2025 would be zero-emission, backed by tax incentives. The target was met: zero-emission vehicles (almost all battery electric) accounted for about 96% of new passenger car sales in Norway in 2025.
evidence: BEV share of new car sales reached ~95.9% in January 2025 and ~96% for the year
Norway became the first country to effectively complete the switch to electric new-car sales

promise: We expect to regain process leadership by 2025
description: At the 'Intel Unleashed' IDM 2.0 event, Gelsinger promised a 5-nodes-in-4-years roadmap (Intel 7/4/3/20A/18A) that would restore Intel's chipmaking lead over TSMC by 2025. Intel 18A was delayed from H2 2024 to 2025, TSMC's N2 kept the process lead, and Gelsinger was ousted as CEO in December 2024 before the goal was reached; Intel's first 18A product (Panther Lake) only shipped in late 2025. Process leadership was not regained in the promised window.
evidence: IDM 2.0 announced March 23, 2021 with 'regain process leadership' from TSMC as the goal
Intel delayed 18A (originally 2024 target) into 2025
Gelsinger removed as CEO December 2, 2024
TSMC (N2, 2025) retained the process lead; Panther Lake (18A) shipped late 2025

promise: London to be Uber's first net-zero city — the entire London fleet electric by the end of 2025
description: Uber backtracked in 2025 — with latest figures showing it 'less than halfway' to the goal; the pledge was effectively abandoned.

promise: Cruise robotaxi unit to generate $1 billion in annual revenue by 2025
description: Cruise paused robotaxi operations in Oct 2023 after an accident, pulled in only ~$500M cumulative with over $10B in losses, and GM shut down the unit in Dec 2024.

promise: Self-driving 'Apple Car' to launch around 2025 (reported internal target, Bloomberg, Dec 2020)
description: Apple canceled its electric car project in February 2024 after a decade of effort, with team members reassigned to AI work.

promise: 'We want to get a billion people in virtual reality' (Oculus Connect 5, Oct 2017)
description: By 2025 the global active VR headset install base was still roughly 30-50 million — orders of magnitude short of the billion-user goal.

promise: Raise the child tax credit from $2,000 to $5,000 per child (Aug 2024 campaign pledge)
description: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (signed 4 Jul 2025) raised the credit only to $2,200, inflation-indexed, with the refundable portion unchanged — no $5,000 credit was ever enacted.

promise: That the war would end in 2025 if his Victory Plan was implemented (plan's geopolitical goal: 'end of the Russo-Ukrainian war')
description: The war continued through all of 2025 and into 2026 — US–Russia and European peace drafts were still circulating in Nov 2025 and no final settlement had been reached by mid-2026.

promise: Free nutritious meals (Makan Bergizi Gratis) for schoolchildren, pregnant women and toddlers — targeting 82.9 million beneficiaries
description: Launched on schedule (6 Jan 2025) but scaled back: per-meal budget cut to Rp10,000 (from Rp15–20,000), only ~30 million recipients reached by Sept 2025, Rp171trn budget vs Rp420trn needed for full-year operation, 20,000+ food-poisoning cases in 2025, and corruption arrests at the program body in June 2026.

promise: Reduce poverty
description: Poverty first spiked from 41.7% to a peak of 57.4% (Jan 2024) after the shock, then fell to 31.6% in H1 2025 (lowest since 2018, below the 2023 starting point); extreme poverty fell from 18.2% to 7.4%.

promise: Campaign pledge (2023): dollarize the economy and abolish the central bank
description: Dollarization was abandoned — instead of dollarizing, the government kept the peso, dismantled the 'cepo' capital controls on 14 Apr 2025 and moved to a managed float in a ~1,000–1,400 ARS/USD band under a US$20bn IMF agreement.

promise: Increase medical school admissions by 2,000 per year to fix the doctor shortage (announced 6 Feb 2024)
description: The quota increase triggered a mass doctors' strike; the 2025 increase was cut to +1,500 (May 2024) and in April 2025 the government reverted the 2026 quota to the original 3,058 — the promise largely unravelled before his removal.

promise: Keep the federal carbon price as the cornerstone of climate policy
description: He carved out home heating oil (Oct 2023), and the consumer carbon tax was repealed outright on 1 Apr 2025 (prime-ministerial directive signed by Carney on 14 Mar 2025, weeks after Trudeau left office).

promise: Cut immigration levels to ease housing and social pressures
description: Permanent-resident targets were cut from 500,000 to 395,000 (2025), 380,000 (2026) and 365,000 (2027), and the plans were implemented.

promise: Present major European defence funding proposals within 100 days of her second Commission — delivered as ReArm Europe
description: ReArm Europe was announced 4 Mar 2025: up to €800bn for defence, including a €150bn joint-loans facility, endorsed by the European Council on 6 Mar 2025 (later rebranded Readiness 2030).

promise: Allies must move to a 'wartime mindset' and raise defence spending far above 2% of GDP
description: The Hague Summit Declaration (25 Jun 2025) set a new 5%-of-GDP target for 2035 (at least 3.5% core defence + up to 1.5% defence-related spending), replacing the 2014 2% benchmark — all members except Spain signed on.

promise: We're targeting 150 million DTC subscribers by 2025 (as reported).
description: At its February 2022 investor day, Paramount projected 150 million global direct-to-consumer subscribers by 2025. Paramount+ ended 2025 with roughly 70-75 million subscribers; the company was sold to Skydance in 2025, far short of target.
evidence: Investor Day guidance of 150M DTC subs by 2025 reported by Variety/CNBC
Paramount+ subscriber base stayed near 70M through 2024-2025

role: CEO, The New York Times Company
promise: We intend to reach 10 million subscriptions by 2025 (as reported).
description: NYT's May 2020 strategic report set a goal of 10 million total subscriptions by 2025, powered by digital growth. The company passed 10.5 million subscriptions in Q4 2024, ahead of the deadline.
evidence: NYT 2020 strategy report set 10M subscription goal by 2025
Company reported ~10.5M subscriptions in Q4 2024

promise: Grand Theft Auto VI — coming 2025.

Zelnick confirmed fall 2025 guidance through February 2025 earnings
Delay to fall 2026 announced 2025-05-15

promise: OpenAI projected ~$11.6 billion in annualized revenue for 2025
description: Investor-facing projections (reported Sept 2024) put OpenAI at $11.6B in 2025 revenue; Altman later pushed higher targets in internal letters (reported Dec 2024) and 2025 guidance reached $17B. Reported 2025 revenue of ~$13.1B beat the $11.6B projection (though it fell short of the later $17B stretch target).
evidence: The Hindu/Reuters: 'OpenAI sees $11.6 billion revenue next year' (Sep 28, 2024)
OpenAI 2025 revenue $13.1B (Wikipedia infobox)
CFO Sarah Friar signaled ~$11B (Feb 2025); Mar 2025 reports cited $17B target

promise: "AI-designed drugs will enter clinical trials this year" (2025)

Isomorphic Labs said it was 'very close' (July 2025), then Reuters reported a delay (Jan 20, 2026); human trials for AI-designed drugs launched around April 2026. So the milestone arrived roughly a year late.

Isomorphic 'very close' to human trials (Fast Company, Jul 7, 2025)
Reuters: 'Isomorphic Labs delays clinical trial timeline' (Jan 20, 2026)
WIRED: 'AI-Designed Drugs by a DeepMind Spinoff Are Headed to Human Trials' (Apr 24, 2026)

promise: "It's a new day in search" / "The race starts today, and we're going to move and move fast" — AI-powered Bing would challenge Google and win users ("we made them come to Bing and see it")
description: At the AI-Bing launch (Feb 7, 2023) and in The Verge interviews the same day, Nadella vowed to take search share from Google with the new AI assistant. Bing's share stayed stuck around 3-4% through 2025-2026 (Google ~90%); the promised search-share shift never materialized. Exact launch quotes verified from The Verge article text.
evidence: Verbatim quotes verified via The Verge (Feb 7, 2023)
Bing share ~3-4% vs Google ~90% through 2025-2026 (Statcounter)

promise: "Gemini 3 will be released later this year" (2025)
description: On the Q2 2025 earnings call Pichai said Gemini 3 would arrive later in 2025 (reiterated in Oct 2025: 'Gemini 3.0 will release this year'). Google shipped Gemini 3 Pro on November 18, 2025, with Deep Think and Flash versions following in Dec 2025 — a rare on-time flagship promise.
evidence: Pichai remarks on Alphabet Q2 2025 earnings call (Jul 22, 2025)
Techzine Global (Oct 17, 2025): 'Sundar Pichai: Gemini 3.0 will release this year'
Gemini 3 Pro released Nov 18, 2025 (Wikipedia: Gemini)

promise: Salesforce aimed to 'empower a billion AI agents by 2025' via Agentforce
description: At Agentforce's launch/Dreamforce 2024, Benioff predicted a billion AI agents would be deployed by end of 2025. Agentforce grew fast (8,000+ customers by May 2025; Salesforce later touted 'billions of conversations' handled), but no verifiable metric of 1 billion deployed agents emerged; Salesforce reframed success around customers and conversations instead.
evidence: Salesforce press release (Sep 12, 2024); Mi-3.com.au (Sep 16, 2024): 'aim to empower a billion AI agents by 2025'
CFO Dive (May 29, 2025): 'over 8,000 customers using new agentic AI tool'
No public accounting of 1B agents as of end-2025

promise: Renewables are set to overtake coal as the largest source of global electricity generation by 2025.
description: IEA's Renewables 2021 report (Dec 2021) predicted renewables would surpass coal in global power generation by 2025 - and ahead of coal-skeptic commentary. Ember's data show it happened in 2024, a year early.
evidence: Ember Global Electricity Review 2025: renewables ~32% of global electricity in 2024 vs coal ~28%
Solar became the largest single electricity source by 2025; IEA Renewables 2024 confirmed 'renewables to overtake coal by early 2025'

promise: Reach 35 GW of gross renewable electricity capacity by 2025 (raised to 60 GW at COP26), heading toward 100 GW by 2030.
description: TotalEnergies pledged 35 GW of renewables by 2025 in February 2021 and raised this to 60 GW at COP26 (November 2021). Actual gross installed capacity was ~30 GW at end-2024 and ~35 GW around end-2025 - the original 35 GW was met only at the deadline, and the raised 60 GW target was clearly missed.
evidence: ~30 GW gross renewables at end-2024 (TotalEnergies Q4 2024 release) vs 60 GW raised target
Original 35 GW target reached only around the December 2025 deadline
100 GW by 2030 target also re-scoped as the company pivoted back toward LNG

promise: Be carbon neutral in own operations and energy generation by 2025, with 95% of energy from renewables by 2023 and 99% by 2025.
description: Ørsted's 2018 strategy ('Making Green Energy Affordable') set carbon-neutral operations by 2025 and a 99% green share by 2025. The company reported achieving ~99% green generation and carbon-neutral status by 2024-2025, hitting both milestones.
evidence: Wikipedia Ørsted: target of >95% green energy by 2023 and 99% by 2025; achieved
Ørsted 2024/2025 reporting confirms carbon neutrality in own operations and generation, with carbon intensity down ~99% vs 2006

role: Secretary of State for Energy and Climate Change, UK
promise: Phase out unabated coal-fired power generation by 2025.
description: The UK announced in November 2015 (first G7 country to do so) that it would end coal power by 2025, later legislated. Ratcliffe-on-Soar - the last plant - closed on 30 September 2024, about 15 months early.
evidence: Ratcliffe-on-Soar closed 30 September 2024 at midnight, ending 142 years of UK coal (Wikipedia)
Closure came ahead of the 2025 pledge; coal's share of UK power fell from ~23% (2015) to zero

promise: The Government must act now to halt biodiversity loss and reduce net greenhouse gas emissions to zero by 2025.
description: Extinction Rebellion's founding demand (UK, Oct 2018) was net-zero UK emissions by 2025. The UK remained at roughly 370-380 MtCO2e in 2024-2025 with a legal net-zero date of 2050 - the 2025 demand was never adopted or met.
evidence: Wikipedia Extinction Rebellion: Demand 2 = 'reduce greenhouse gas emissions to net-zero by 2025' (Oct 2018)
UK 2024/2025 emissions still ~370 MtCO2e, far from zero (DESNZ statistics)

description: Tesla closed 2025 at ~$400 (post-split; ~$1,200 on ARK's then-basis) — roughly 60-85% below target

promise: NVIDIA will open the Boston-based Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC) and begin operations later in 2025
description: At GTC 2025 Huang announced the NVIDIA Accelerated Quantum Research Center in Boston, saying it would begin operations later that year. NVIDIA now lists NVAQC as an operating facility integrating quantum hardware with DGX Quantum systems, but the center was still hiring its Boston engineering team in March 2026, indicating full operations slipped past the 2025 target.
evidence: NVAQC announced March 2025 with a 'later this year' start
NVIDIA NVAQC page active in 2026; senior Boston engineering hires posted March 2026

promise: Tesla's robotaxi service will cover half of the US population by the end of 2025
description: Throughout 2025 Musk promised that Tesla's robotaxi service would expand far beyond its June 2025 Austin launch — claiming the fleet in Austin would reach 500 vehicles and that the service would 'cover half the US population' by the end of the year. By December 2025 the service remained a small, geofenced Austin operation with safety monitors in cars; an eight-month status check found roughly 19% availability and most of Musk's milestones unmet.
evidence: Austin fleet far below 500 vehicles; service never expanded beyond limited geofenced areas in 2025
Electrek (Dec 2025): 19% availability, all major 2025 robotaxi promises missing

promise: Tesla will reach production capacity of 250,000 Cybertrucks per year by 2025
description: At the Cybertruck delivery event (July 2023) Musk said Tesla could reach annual production capacity of about 250,000 Cybertrucks by 2025. Actual results were a fraction of the target: roughly 39,000 units in 2024, falling to about 20,200 in 2025 as sales dropped 68% year-on-year in the final quarter — barely 8% of the promised rate.
evidence: 2025 Cybertruck sales ~20,200, about 8% of the 250,000 target
Production capacity settled at 125,000 units, well below the promised 250,000

promise: Executive order ending birthright citizenship — "This is a big one."
description: On his first day back in office Trump signed Executive Order 14160, 'Protecting the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship', seeking to end birthright citizenship for children of undocumented or temporary residents. Federal courts blocked it, and in June 2026 the US Supreme Court struck it down by a 6-3 vote, holding that children born on US soil are citizens regardless of their parents' status.
evidence: Supreme Court struck down EO 14160 in a 6-3 ruling in June 2026
Order never took effect; courts blocked it from the start

promise: Claude Opus 4.5 will arrive later in 2025
description: After Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.5 in September 2025, the company said the flagship Opus 4.5 would follow later that year. Claude Opus 4.5 launched on November 24, 2025, touted as the best model for coding, agents and computer use, and scoring 80.9% on SWE-bench Verified.
evidence: Claude Opus 4.5 released November 24, 2025
Announcement followed Sonnet 4.5 (Sept 2025) and Haiku 4.5 (Oct 2025), matching the promised cadence

promise: DGX Spark, the $3,999 personal AI supercomputer, will be available in 2025
description: At GTC 2025 Huang introduced DGX Spark, a GB10 Grace Blackwell desktop AI supercomputer priced at $3,999, saying it would be available later in the year. After months of delay, NVIDIA began selling DGX Spark on October 15, 2025 through Nvidia.com and third-party retailers.
evidence: DGX Spark went on sale October 15, 2025 at $3,999
Launch came after several months of delays from the initially expected mid-2025 availability

promise: Blackwell Ultra (GB300) platforms will start shipping in the second half of 2025
description: At GTC 2025 Huang announced the Blackwell Ultra GPU and the GB300 NVL72 and B300 NVL16 platforms, saying shipments would begin in the second half of 2025. In August 2025 Huang confirmed the Blackwell Ultra GB300 AI platform was in full-scale mass production with output ramping successfully, meeting the H2 2025 window.
evidence: GB300 NVL72 entered full-scale mass production by August 2025
Shipments began in H2 2025 as promised at GTC

promise: SpaceX will perform up to 25 Starship orbital launches in 2025
description: An FAA filing detailed SpaceX plans for up to 25 Starship orbital launches, 25 Super Heavy booster landings and 25 Starship landings in 2025, a goal echoed by SpaceX executives as '25 in 25'. The company fell far short: launch records show a total of 12 Starship flights through mid-2026, including earlier test flights, and the target was carried forward to 2026.
evidence: Only a single-digit number of Starship flights occurred in 2025
Launch-count trackers list 12 total Starship launches through July 2026; '25 in 25' goal not met

promise: OpenAI will restructure into a public benefit corporation
description: OpenAI announced plans in late December 2024 to restructure its nonprofit-for-profit hybrid into a public benefit corporation (PBC) to attract the investment needed for frontier AI. The long-delayed restructuring completed on October 28, 2025, when OpenAI announced it had become a PBC and signed a new agreement with Microsoft.
evidence: OpenAI announced completion of the restructuring on October 28, 2025
NYT: OpenAI 'had become a public benefit corporation' after 18+ months of effort

promise: Claude 4, including the flagship Opus 4 model, will be released in 2025
description: After months of delays and statements that the next-generation Claude flagship was coming, Anthropic launched Claude 4 on May 22, 2025 with two models — Opus 4, described as the world's best coding model at launch, and Sonnet 4 — well within the year.
evidence: Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 launched May 22, 2025

promise: NVIDIA will release Isaac GR00T N1, the first open humanoid-robot foundation model
description: At GTC 2025 Huang announced NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1, the world's first open foundation model for generalized humanoid robot reasoning and skills, available immediately. The model was demonstrated running on 1X's NEO Gamma humanoid and has since become the basis of NVIDIA's GR00T humanoid program, including the 2026 reference robot built with Unitree.
evidence: GR00T N1 released at GTC on March 18, 2025 as open weights
Demonstrated on 1X's NEO Gamma at launch; used in NVIDIA's later humanoid reference designs

promise: "In 2025, I expect Meta AI will be the leading assistant serving more than 1 billion people."
description: In a January 2025 Facebook post announcing Meta's $60-65 billion AI investment year, Zuckerberg said he expected Meta AI to become the leading assistant serving more than 1 billion people in 2025. Meta AI passed the milestone early: Zuckerberg said at the May 2025 shareholder meeting that the assistant had reached 1 billion monthly active users in Q1 2025, up from roughly 600 million in 2024.
evidence: Meta AI reached ~1 billion monthly actives in Q1 2025 (Meta Q1 earnings: 'almost 1 billion')

In September 2025 he signed a further order advancing the sale of TikTok's US assets, with Oracle handling US data security, after reaching an agreement with China's Xi Jinping.
evidence: Executive order of April 4, 2025 kept TikTok operational while a US sale was brokered
September 2025 order advanced the sale with Oracle responsible for US data security
